policy: Only English-language source files are committed. Structured CSV tables were integrated; the original workbook and non-English narrative files were not copied verbatim.
limitations: The input research snapshot did not include raw candle archives for independent local row counting.
VERIFIED records are not equivalent to a fully downloaded and counted archive.
Publisher-reported counts and theoretical calendar slots remain separately labeled.
The archive hash identifies the user-provided research input but the ZIP itself is not bundled in this repository.
